City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
May 7, 2012
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of certificate of appointment to John Carmody (Public Safety and Traffic Commission).
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL They may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City Council Meeting and the Adjourned City Council Meeting held April 16, 2012, and Special City Council meeting held April 20, 2012. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
April 20, 2012 Minutes
April 16, 2012 Minutes
April 16, 2012 Adjorned Meeting Minutes
b.
Approval of Demands
Demands - Staff report 05/07/2012
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff report - 05/07/2012 #5.D.
e.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report -05/07/2012 #5.E.
f.
Report dealing with activities of the public works department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff report - 05/07/2012 5.F.
g.
Report presenting the Treasurer's Report. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report -05/07/2012 #5.G.
h.
Report recommending that interviews for one (1) term expiration on the Planning Commission and five (5) vacancies on the Railroad Museum Foundation Board be scheduled for May 21, 2012 at 6:30PM. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report -05/07/2012 #5.H.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
